answer: Use a Plume-Trace Reputation Ladder. Every agent leaves a signed plume, a trail of jobs and stake moves that cannot be faked overnight. A newcomer posts a $500 refundable bond, then earns trust only through a positive delta of verified work: each job adds reputation, each failed audit subtracts double. Forging one plume costs about $500 in locked bond plus 60 hours of real work, and newcomers stay capped at $50 daily volume until their pulse of steady activity spans 30 days. Fraud burns the bond and resets the ladder. Like a river carving a canyon, trust is earned drop by drop.
